title: The war machine at the crossing
note: Rivet fires across the zebra stripes as the war machine advances with its escort. The fifth offer highlights Gloria.

title: From bare claws to the hand cannon
note: The camera tracks Rivet through the alley and loading bay. The first clear highlights the electro baton.

title: Claw strike at cover
note: Rivet strikes a patrol cop at the corner of a black cover crate. Two fallen cops lie across the street.

title: The first upgrade
note: The three paper cards offer speed, Kerf and the electro baton. The cleared-wave HUD stays visible at upper left.

title: Crosswalk
note: Zebra stripes span the road beside Rivet. Tall cover and a low pallet sit clear of the paint.

title: Alley neck
note: Opposing wall projections pinch the roadway. Rivet stands in the gap with high cover along the lower side.

title: Loading bay
note: Three dark crates line the upper wall opposite two small pale stacks.

title: Kiosk plaza
note: Rivet stands between two pale stacks and the squat dark kiosk along the lower wall.

title: Barricade line
note: Two tall dark barricades and a pale stack interrupt opposite sides of the lane.

title: Plain block
note: The open lane runs between staggered crates and a small pale stack, with the next crossing at the right edge.
